title: bwbench ratio result
description: One run of `bwbench compare` on one machine: interleaved ratios between environments (src/bwbench/ratios.py). bwbench.ratios.problems() checks a file against this schema and what it cannot express.

format.description: The shape of this file. A breaking change bumps the number.

tier.description: Who ran it, as the writer claims: the benchmark node, a GitHub-hosted runner, or someone else's machine. Only an attestation of the file proves 'hosted'.

machine.description: A label for the machine, such as the runner image ('GitHub ubuntu24'). Never a host name.

created.description: When the run started, UTC, RFC 3339.

commit.description: The commit of this repository that measured, or null outside a checkout.

run.description: The GitHub Actions run's URL, or null outside Actions.

rounds.description: Interleaved rounds per comparison. Every arm that is not missing has one time per round.

repeats.description: Timed calls per arm per round, after one untimed warm-up call in the same process. The round's time is their median.

seed.description: Seed of the run order and of the bootstrap.

fingerprint.description: The machine, from the process that ran the comparisons (src/bwbench/fingerprint.py). Its python and lock describe that process, not the arms.

id.description: Which comparison: solvers, install-path, python, bw2calc-release, bw2data-release (bwbench.compare.COMPARISONS).

case.description: The benchmark timed, by its key in benchmarks/descriptions.toml.

baseline.description: The arm every ratio divides by.

installer.description: uv from PyPI, or pixi from conda-forge.

python.description: The Python minor version asked for, such as '3.13'.

requirements.description: What was asked for, before resolution.

solver.description: The solver bw2calc used: superlu, umfpack or pypardiso; null when the case never imported bw2calc or the arm is missing.

versions.description: Installed versions of the packages that matter here (bw2calc, bw2data, numpy, scipy, the solvers).

fingerprint.description: The arm's environment (src/bwbench/fingerprint.py), its lock the resolved set. Null only when the environment could not be built.

seconds.description: The arm's time per round in seconds, in round order: context, not the result. Empty when missing.

missing.description: Why the arm has no times (cannot install here, solver unavailable), or null. A missing arm is no result, never a zero.

candidate.description: The arm divided by the baseline.

ratio.description: Geometric mean over rounds of candidate seconds / baseline seconds. Below 1 the candidate is faster; 1 / ratio is its speed-up.

ci95.description: Percentile bootstrap 95% interval of the ratio, resampling whole rounds: [low, high].

seconds.description: The median time per round of each side, in seconds: context only.

missing.description: Why there is no ratio (an arm is missing), or null.
